# DevManager

> **File:** `services/core/DevManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Dev mode, which axiom switches while it runs (`axiom dev`, docs/dev/backend/README.md): the schema follows its YAML, a tree whose schema isn't the binary's may save, and an edit to the Go source builds a binary axiom re-execs into. State comes from BackendManager.dev; a build that fails sends a notification.

### Properties

- `enabled` (readonly bool)
- `available` (readonly bool): Edits to the Go source can be built here (the tree has it, go is installed); unavailable says why not
- `unavailable` (readonly string)
- `building` (readonly bool)
- `lastBuild` (readonly var): { ok, at, output }, null before the first build this run
- `onDevBuild` (readonly bool): Running a dev build rather than the installed binary
- `offMakesReadOnly` (readonly bool): Turning dev mode off would leave the config read-only (the tree's schema isn't the binary's) until the binary is rebuilt

### Functions

- `setEnabled(on)`
- `toggle()`
- `rebuild()`
